description_en: Nugaḥ Phalcā faces east and is located on the road from Nugaḥ Ṭola to Oku Bāhāḥ. Several otherphalcāsand temples can be found in its vicinity. This three-bayed Phalcā has a pointed roof and is engaged to a building in the south. The structure is a rare type of amandaḥ phalcāwith 16 columns. According to a member of the Ṭola Sudhāra Samiti, this latticework was installed to prevent street children and 'strangers' from using it. These days the Samiti uses the Phalcā as a storeroom. Before the Phalcā was closed through latticework between the bays on three sides, devotees used to light oil-lamps and sit inside its bays during the procession of Buṅgadyaḥ. They would do this when the chariot arrived at Nugaḥ Ṭola.The (still open) Phalcā can be seen from one corner in a photograph published inPruscha(1975: 181) as well as in a watercolor of Sunadhārā  made by Henry AmbroseOldfield(1987).
description_ne: नुगःटोलबाट ओकुबाहालतिर लाग्ने बाटोको पूर्वपट्टि यो फल्चा अवस्थित छ । स्थानीय भाषामा  १६ वटा थामो भएको वर्गाकार फल्चालाई मन्दः फल्चा भनिने चलन अनुरुप यस फल्चालाई पनि ''मन्दःफल्चा'' भन्ने गरिएको छ । फल्चालाई खुल्ला नराखी प्रत्येक कवलमा काठका फलकहरु हाली बन्द कोठाको रूप दिइएको छ । सडक बालकहरुबाट शौच कार्य भई दुर्गन्धित हुँदै गएको र अपरिचित व्यक्तिहरूले रात काट्ने क्रम बढेपछि फल्चा बन्द गरिएको भनाई टोल सुधार समितिका सदस्यको रहेको छ । हाल सोही समितिले फल्चालाई भण्डार कोठाको रुपमा प्रयोग गर्दै आएको छ । फल्चा बन्द गरिनु पूर्व बुङ्गद्यःको रथ नुगः टोलमा आइपुगे पश्चात भक्तजनहरुबाट फल्चामा बसी दियो बाल्ने गरिन्थ्यो ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)

historical_events.event_description: All bays of the phalcā were closed. The Ṭola Sudhārā Samiti installed doors on the eastern and northern sides, allegedly to prevent the monument being used by homeless persons. In a photo published inPruscha(1975, vol. 2, p. 181, P-186), the Phalcā can be seen in the rightr corner without doors and closed bays.
